g.text: Independent launch · cerebellum · fixed RR23 directions · 19 held-out animals in three route–age strata
All eligible events used; no RR23 significance filter. Measurement: ≥20 pair reads and ≥90% boundary dominance in every animal.
RR23 flight and collection day are aliased. Results describe cohort associations and do not establish causal flight effects or functional injury.
